description: OS input methods in every Minecraft text field: marked text inline, candidate window in place (Fabric, 26.3)

mods.name: RichTextCraft
mods.description: OS input methods in every Minecraft text field: marked text drawn inline at the caret, the candidate window under it, and keys left to the input method while it composes.

releases.notes:
First release, for Minecraft 26.3 on Fabric. Needs Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Fabric API and Java 25.

- **Marked text inline.** Text that is still being composed is drawn underlined at the caret, and the clause being converted gets a thicker underline.
- **Candidate window in place.** The OS candidate window appears under the text being converted.
- **Keys go to the input method while it composes.** Enter confirms without sending chat, and Escape cancels without closing the screen.
- **Focus loss commits.** Clicking Done, another field or anywhere else keeps what you were typing.

Works in chat and commands, anvils, searches, command blocks, books, signs, and every other `EditBox` or `MultiLineEditBox`.

Testing: unit tests and in-game tests pass. It has been reported working in Lunar Client 26.3 on macOS. It hasn't been checked yet with each input method listed in [docs/testing.md](https://github.com/team-mirae/rich-text-craft/blob/main/docs/testing.md).
